api_sibling_note: an API-sibling pair contrasts two entry points of the same shape in one contract where exactly one declares an authorisation guard. It is a stronger teaching signal than a generic access-control refutation because the two members are genuinely similar code.
note: every counterexample refutes a hypothesis about a function the finding did NOT name as vulnerable, so it can never contradict its own finding. Records with no counterexample are counted with the reason rather than padded with a weak one.
